## MSADrawOptions.darkMode property

Render for a dark background. Canvas can't read CSS theme tokens, so this has to be an explicit value; it defaults to whether the host has a `dark` class on `<html>`<!-- -->, the same convention the shipped stylesheet uses.

**Signature:**

```typescript
darkMode?: boolean;
```
